system.description:
At 13th level, your reputation expands further as your legend grows. Your prestige increases by 1 and you may choose between the following options:

Fancy Dan: Your flashy ways have spoiled your reputation to some degree, leading most gunfighters to assume you’re all flash and no substance. You may always choose to roll Sleight of Hand when rolling initiative, and if you roll initiative while you have no exertion you immediately gain 3 exertion.

One Shot: You have a reputation for taking down your opponents in one devastating shot. When you roll a critical hit with a light firearm you may expend up to 3 exertion to increase the damage of the critical hit by 1 weapon damage die per exertion point spent.

Songbird: You are well known for having a particular auditory cue. Often a whistled leitmotif or short musical phrase. You may always choose to use Performance to roll initiative. If you have a visibly holstered, or readied, light firearm when you use Performance to roll initiative, creatures within the normal range of the light firearm must make a Wisdom save against your combat maneuver defense or become rattled for a number of turns equal to your Prestige rating.
